s0101.literal: The princes were granted gold, silver, coin, and silk according to the annual custom.
s0101.idiomatic: Princes received gold, silver, currency, and silk as in the annual custom.

s0102.literal: Hail at Zhangde, Daming, Nanjing, Henan Prefecture, Jinan, Zilai, Taiyuan, and Hong Prefecture; locusts and drought at Xijing, Beijing, Yidu, Zhending, Dongping, Shunde, Hejian, Xu, Su, and Pi; frost damage at Taiyuan.
s0102.idiomatic: Zhangde, Daming, Nanjing, Henan Prefecture, Jinan, Zilai, Taiyuan, and Hong were struck by hail; Xijing, Beijing, Yidu, Zhending, Dongping, Shunde, Hejian, Xu, Su, and Pi suffered locusts and drought; killing frost hit Taiyuan.

s0103.literal: Forty-two persons were sentenced to death.
s0103.idiomatic: Forty-two persons were sentenced to death.

s0104.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on the yimao new moon, King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent envoys to offer congratulations.
s0104.idiomatic: In the third year, on the yimao new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent envoys with greetings.

s0105.literal: On bingwu day Duo Duan and Zhao Bi were dispatched bearing an edict to reassure and instruct the officers, troops, and people of Sichuan.
s0105.idiomatic: On bingwu day Duo Duan and Zhao Bi were sent with an edict to pacify Sichuan's officers, soldiers, and civilians.

s0106.literal: On renzi day the State Revenues Commission was established, with Ahmad as commissioner.
s0106.idiomatic: On renzi day the commission for state revenues was created and Ahmad was made its commissioner.

s0107.literal: On guichou day two thousand Jurchen troops were selected for the Palace Guard.
s0107.idiomatic: On guichou day two thousand Jurchen soldiers were chosen for the palace guard.

s0108.literal: The Sichuan Branch Privy Council planned to take Jiading and requested reinforcements; Duo Duan and Zhao Bi were ordered to detach six thousand Mongol and Han troops from the various wings and hand them over.
s0108.idiomatic: The Sichuan branch privy council planned an attack on Jiading and asked for reinforcements; Duo Duan and Zhao Bi were ordered to detach six thousand Mongol and Han troops from the various wings for the operation.

s0109.literal: In the second month, on bingyin day, Lian Xixian and Song Zizhen were made Grand Councillors; Zhang Wenqian was restored as Left Vice Director of the Central Secretariat; Shi Tianze was made Deputy Privy Councillor.
s0109.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the second month Lian Xixian and Song Zizhen were appointed grand councillors; Zhang Wenqian was restored as left vice director of the Central Secretariat; Shi Tianze was made deputy privy councillor.

s0110.literal: On guiyou day Shen Prefecture was established to settle surrendered Goryeo people.
s0110.idiomatic: On guiyou day Shen Prefecture was created to resettle surrendered Goryeo subjects.

s0111.literal: On renwu day a Buddhist official of Pingyang Circuit who had deluded the people with heterodox talk was executed.
s0111.idiomatic: On renwu day a Pingyang circuit monk-official who had led the people astray with heterodox preaching was put to death.

s0112.literal: Right Vice Director of the Central Secretariat Zhang Yi was made concurrent controller of the State Revenues Commission and Counsellor; Zhang Hui was made deputy commissioner of state revenues.
s0112.idiomatic: Right vice director Zhang Yi was also put in charge of the state revenues commission as counsellor, and Zhang Hui was made its deputy commissioner.

s0113.literal: On guimao day the imperial carriage went to Shangdu.
s0113.idiomatic: On guimao day the Emperor went to Shangdu.

s0114.literal: On jiashen day the Western Xia Branch Secretariat was abolished and a Pacification Commission was established.
s0114.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Western Xia branch secretariat was abolished and a pacification commission was set up in its place.

s0115.literal: Regulations were first drawn up for the caps and robes of the Directorate of Ritual Music.
s0115.idiomatic: The first regulations were issued for the caps and robes of the ritual-music directorate.

s0116.literal: Pacification commissions were established for the routes of Dongjing, Guangning, Yizhou, Kaiyuan, Tupin, Helan, and Posa.
s0116.idiomatic: Pacification commissions were established at Dongjing, Guangning, Yizhou, Kaiyuan, Tupin, Helan, and Posa.

s0117.literal: On yiyou day one quarter of this year's lump-sum silver payment in the Central Capital was remitted.
s0117.idiomatic: On yiyou day one quarter of this year's lump-sum silver dues in the Central Capital were remitted.

s0118.literal: An edict ordered settlement of the captive population and livestock under Aju's command and of grasslands where civilians had encroached to plant crops.
s0118.idiomatic: An edict ordered adjudication of captives and livestock under Aju's command and of grazing lands where civilians had encroached to farm.

s0119.literal: The regulations of the State Revenues Commission were promulgated to officials within and without.
s0119.idiomatic: The state revenues commission's regulations were issued to officials throughout the realm.

s0120.literal: In the third month, on xinsi day, Weihui Circuit was divided out as the appanage of Prince Yulong Tash.
s0120.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the third month Weihui circuit was detached as the appanage of Prince Yulong Tash.

s0121.literal: On wuxu day the Uda households were given famine relief.
s0121.idiomatic: On wuxu day Uda households received famine relief.

s0122.literal: Wang Jin, Palace Attendant He Zhesi, and Transport Commissioner Wang Ming of Jinan and Yidu, for concealing salt levies, were all executed.
s0122.idiomatic: Wang Jin, palace attendant He Zhesi, and Wang Ming, transport commissioner of Jinan and Yidu, were all executed for concealing salt revenues.

s0123.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on dingmao day, the Five Mountains rare-tribute couch was completed and the Broad Cold Hall was placed on Qionghua Isle.
s0123.idiomatic: On dingmao day in the fourth month of summer the Five Mountains imperial couch was finished and the Broad Cold Hall was built on Qionghua Isle.

s0124.literal: Hu Jin and others, wanhu of the Bozhou naval force, led cavalry across the Fei River, crossed Jing Mountain, fought Song troops, killed and captured a great multitude, and were rewarded with notes and silks in varying amounts.
s0124.idiomatic: Hu Jin and other wanhu of the Bozhou naval force led cavalry across the Fei, crossed Jing Mountain, routed Song forces, and took many prisoners; they were rewarded with notes and silks in varying amounts.

s0125.literal: On gengwu day an order directed Buddhist and Daoist clergy to pray for blessings at temples and monasteries in the Central Capital.
s0125.idiomatic: On gengwu day Buddhist and Daoist clergy were ordered to pray for blessings at temples in the Central Capital.

s0126.literal: An edict made Sengji overall supervisor and lodged him at Guangshou Temple.
s0126.idiomatic: An edict named Sengji chief supervisor and installed him at Guangshou Temple.

s0127.literal: On jimao day the prohibition on coastal private salt was strictly enforced.
s0127.idiomatic: On jimao day the ban on coastal private salt was sharply reinforced.

s0128.literal: An order forbade painted decoration on palace candles.
s0128.idiomatic: Palace candles were ordered kept free of painted decoration.

s0129.literal: In the fifth month, on yimao day, envoys were dispatched to every route to review prisoners.
s0129.idiomatic: On yimao day in the fifth month envoys were sent to every route to review prisoners.

s0130.literal: On gengzi day the Imperial Medical Academy was ordered to oversee medical households and public-benefit pharmacies on all routes.
s0130.idiomatic: On gengzi day the imperial medical academy was put in charge of medical households and public-benefit pharmacies on every route.

s0131.literal: On xinchou day the armillary sphere was gilded with gold.
s0131.idiomatic: On xinchou day the armillary sphere was gilded with gold.

s0132.literal: On bingwu day the Hanyan, Tanglai, and other canals in Zhongxing, Western Xia, were dredged.
s0132.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Hanyan, Tanglai, and other canals at Zhongxing in Western Xia were dredged.

s0133.literal: Where good fields had been taken by monks, Mongols were allowed to divide and cultivate them.
s0133.idiomatic: Good farmland held by monks was opened to Mongols for divided cultivation.

s0134.literal: On bingchen day the Yidu Branch Secretariat was abolished.
s0134.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Yidu branch secretariat was abolished.

s0135.literal: Half the taxes of hostage households in Pingluan and Yidu were remitted.
s0135.idiomatic: Taxes on hostage households in Pingluan and Yidu were cut in half.

s0136.literal: In the sixth month, on dingmao day, Prince Namohe was enfeoffed as Prince of Beiping and given a seal.
s0136.idiomatic: On dingmao day in the sixth month Prince Namohe was enfeoffed as Prince of Beiping and given a seal.

s0137.literal: On xinwei day people of Guizhou origin were moved to garrison farming at Xingji County in Qing Prefecture, and oxen and tools were supplied by the state.
s0137.idiomatic: On xinwei day Guizhou settlers were transferred to garrison farming at Xingji County in Qing Prefecture, with oxen and tools supplied by the state.

s0138.literal: On renshen day Liu Zheng was granted fifty qing of land within the capital region.
s0138.idiomatic: On renshen day Liu Zheng received fifty qing of land within the capital region.

s0139.literal: On guiyou day, because the wanhu Zhazha'er had died in royal service, his wife was granted two hundred fifty taels of silver.
s0139.idiomatic: On guiyou day, because wanhu Zhazha'er had died in the Emperor's service, his wife received two hundred fifty taels of silver.

s0140.literal: On bingzi day the Grain Transport Commission was established.
s0140.idiomatic: On bingzi day the grain transport commission was established.

s0141.literal: On wuyin day, because Grand Councillor Sayyid Ajall and others of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat had governed well, five thousand taels of silver were granted.
s0141.idiomatic: On wuyin day Sayyid Ajall and his colleagues on the Shaanxi branch secretariat received five thousand taels of silver for effective administration.

s0142.literal: Deputy Commander-in-Chief Wang Zhongren of Shandong was ordered to supervise the building of warships at Bian.
s0142.idiomatic: Wang Zhongren, deputy commander-in-chief of Shandong, was ordered to oversee warship construction at Bian.

s0143.literal: The prohibition on bamboo in Shaanxi and Henan was strictly enforced.
s0143.idiomatic: The ban on bamboo in Shaanxi and Henan was sharply reinforced.

s0145.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingshen day, the Xizhou Pacification Commission was abolished.
s0145.idiomatic: On bingshen day in the seventh month of autumn the Xizhou pacification commission was abolished.

s0146.literal: On renyin day an edict stated that when the imperial carriage toured, the Shangdu Route chief office was to perform capital-garrison duties, and when the carriage returned it was to revert to its former functions.
s0146.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict ordered that when the Emperor toured, the Shangdu route chief office should act as the capital garrison administration, resuming its former duties when he returned.

s0147.literal: On bingwu day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Five Sacred Peaks and Four Rivers.
s0147.idiomatic: On bingwu day envoys were sent to offer sacrifice at the five sacred peaks and four great rivers.

s0148.literal: On jiayin day patrol troops within and without were increased.
s0148.idiomatic: On jiayin day patrol forces in the capital and in the provinces were increased.

s0149.literal: On each outer route one person of middling means was chosen from every hundred households to serve; his levy was paid by the remaining households, and in the capital four hundred Wuwei Guard troops were added.
s0149.idiomatic: In the outer routes one man of middling means was chosen from every hundred households to serve, with his tax paid by the rest; in the capital four hundred Wuwei guard troops were added.

s0150.literal: On jiwei day the four prefectures of Guo, Dai, Jian, and Tai were placed under Xin Prefecture.
s0150.idiomatic: On jiwei day Guo, Dai, Jian, and Tai prefectures were placed under Xin Prefecture.

s0151.literal: An edict ordered people of Western Xia who had fled disorder to return to their native registers, and new subjects in Chengdu sheltered by powerful families were all returned to their prefectures and counties.
s0151.idiomatic: An edict ordered Western Xia refugees to return to their home registers, and Chengdu's new settlers sheltered by powerful families were returned to their counties and prefectures.

s0152.literal: An edict summoned deserters from the army; within one hundred days they were to report to their units and confess, their crimes would be pardoned, and the poor might fulfill service jointly by household.
s0152.idiomatic: An edict called in army deserters: within one hundred days they were to surrender to their units, receive pardon, and the poor might meet service obligations jointly by household.

s0153.literal: In the eighth month, on guihai day, Grand Councillor Bayan was granted one residence.
s0153.idiomatic: On guihai day in the eighth month Grand Councillor Bayan received one residence.

s0154.literal: On dingmao day Vice Minister of War Hei Di and Vice Minister of Rites Yin Hong were sent as envoys to Japan, granted a letter stating: "The Emperor addresses the King of Japan: From of old, when rulers of small states shared a border, they still strove for good faith and friendly relations — how much more so, when my ancestors received Heaven's bright command and embraced all within the Four Seas, and countless distant lands and foreign regions have in awe of our might and admiration of our virtue submitted!"
s0154.idiomatic: On dingmao day Hei Di, vice minister of war, and Yin Hong, vice minister of rites, were dispatched to Japan with a letter reading: "The Emperor to the King of Japan: Even rulers of small neighboring states have always sought trust and amity — how much more so for us, whose forebears received Heaven's mandate, rule all China, and count beyond number the far peoples who, awed by our power and drawn by our virtue, have bowed to us."

s0155.literal: At the beginning of my reign, because the innocent people of Goryeo had long suffered under swords and spears, I immediately ordered troops withdrawn, their boundaries restored, and their old and young returned home.
s0155.idiomatic: Early in my reign, seeing Goryeo's innocent people long wasted by war, I at once halted the armies, restored their borders, and sent their old and young home.

s0156.literal: The ruler and ministers of Goryeo, moved by gratitude, came to court; though the relation was that of lord and subject, their joy was like that between father and son.
s0156.idiomatic: Goryeo's king and ministers, full of gratitude, came to court; in name they were lord and subject, yet their warmth was like that of father and son.

s0157.literal: I reckon that Your Majesty's ruler and ministers know this as well.
s0157.idiomatic: Your Majesty's court knows this already, I am sure.

s0158.literal: Goryeo is my eastern vassal state.

s0159.literal: Japan lies close to Goryeo; since founding your state you have at times communicated with China — yet in my own reign not a single envoy has come to open friendly relations.
s0159.idiomatic: Japan lies close to Goryeo. Since your kingdom was founded you have kept intermittent contact with China — yet under Our reign not one carriage of envoys has arrived to seek amity.

s0160.literal: Fearing that your kingdom may not yet know this fully, I specially send envoys bearing this letter to declare my heart's intent, hoping that from now on we may exchange messages and forge friendship, treating one another with close cordiality.
s0160.idiomatic: Lest your kingdom be incompletely informed, I send envoys with this letter to make My intent plain, in hope that hereafter we may exchange messages, bind ourselves in friendship, and live as close allies.

s0161.literal: Moreover, the sage takes all within the Four Seas as one household — if we do not communicate in friendship, how can that accord with the principle of one family?
s0161.idiomatic: The sage embraces the four seas as one home — how can we claim to be one family if we never greet each other in friendship?

s0162.literal: As for resorting to arms, who truly desires it? Your Majesty should ponder this.
s0162.idiomatic: War, when it comes — who truly wants it? Your Majesty should weigh this well.

s0163.literal: " Another edict ordered Goryeo to guide the departing envoys to that country.
s0163.idiomatic: " Another edict ordered Goryeo to guide the envoys on to Japan.

s0164.literal: On wuzi day King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his Grand General Pak Ki to congratulate the Emperor's birthday.
s0164.idiomatic: On wuzi day King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his grand general Pak Ki to congratulate the Emperor on his birthday.

s0165.literal: Aju raided the Qichuan and Huangzhou region; captives numbered in the tens of thousands.
s0165.idiomatic: Aju raided Qichuan and Huangzhou, taking tens of thousands of captives.

s0166.literal: In the ninth month, on wuwu day, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
s0166.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the ninth month the Emperor returned from Shangdu.

s0167.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the gengshen new moon, Dexing Prefecture was reduced to Fengsheng Prefecture.
s0167.idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon of the tenth month of winter Dexing Prefecture was demoted to Fengsheng Prefecture.

s0168.literal: On guihai day the Goryeo envoys returned; because Wang Chon was ill, an edict ordered medicine compounded and granted to him.
s0168.idiomatic: On guihai day the Goryeo envoys returned; learning that Wang Chon was ill, the court ordered medicine prepared and sent to him.

s0169.literal: On dingchou day the classics repository of Pingyang was moved to the capital.
s0169.idiomatic: On dingchou day Pingyang's classics repository was transferred to the capital.

s0170.literal: The old form of edict-dispatch documents was revised.
s0170.idiomatic: The old format for edict-dispatch documents was revised.

s0171.literal: When the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed, Grand Councillors Antong and Bayan said: "The generations of the ancestors, honored posthumous names and temple names, the addition of four generations to the sacrifices, the spirit tablets of each temple, associated meritorious ministers, ritual robes, and sacrificial vessels — all these matters ought to be fixed by deliberation."
s0171.idiomatic: When the imperial ancestral temple was finished, grand councillors Antong and Bayan memorialized: "Generations of ancestors, posthumous honors and temple names, worship of four additional generations, spirit tablets for each shrine, associated meritorious ministers, ritual robes, and sacrificial vessels — all should be settled by deliberation."

s0172.literal: " Grand Councillor Zhao Bi and others were ordered to gather the ministers for deliberation; eight chambers were fixed.
s0172.idiomatic: " Zhao Bi and other grand councillors were ordered to assemble the ministers; eight chambers were decided upon.

s0173.literal: Hunting in the capital region was forbidden.
s0173.idiomatic: Hunting in the capital region was forbidden.

s0174.literal: On renwu day the State Revenues Commission was ordered to manufacture one thousand divine-arm bows and sixty thousand arrows.
s0174.idiomatic: On renwu day the state revenues commission was ordered to make one thousand divine-arm bows and sixty thousand arrows.

s0175.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinmao day, salaries and official fields were first granted to officials of the capital, prefectures, counties, and bureaus.
s0175.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the eleventh month salaries and official fields were first granted to officials of the capital, prefectures, counties, and bureaus.

s0176.literal: On wuxu day grain warehouses were established along the Imperial Canal.
s0176.idiomatic: On wuxu day grain warehouses were built along the imperial canal.

s0177.literal: On dingwei day the prohibition on slaughtering cattle and horses was strictly enforced.
s0177.idiomatic: On dingwei day the ban on slaughtering cattle and horses was sharply reinforced.

s0178.literal: Song Zizhen resigned on grounds of illness.

s0179.literal: On xinhai day Hududar was made Left Grand Councillor of the Central Secretariat.
s0179.idiomatic: On xinhai day Hududar was appointed left grand councillor of the Central Secretariat.

s0180.literal: An edict forbade books on astronomy, prognostication, and the like.
s0180.idiomatic: An edict banned books on astronomy, prognostication, and related subjects.

s0181.literal: On bingchen day the wanhu Sanzhudai, through drunkenness, lost the guard post at Daliangping; the crime merited death, but his prior merit was recorded and he was spared, being ordered to the eastern Sichuan front to redeem himself by service.
s0181.idiomatic: On bingchen day wanhu Sanzhudai, drunk on duty, abandoned the post at Daliangping — a capital offense — but his earlier merit won him reprieve and he was sent to the eastern Sichuan front to redeem himself.

s0182.literal: An edict ordered the capital-construction commissioner to return to court.
s0182.idiomatic: An edict ordered the capital-construction commissioner back to court.

s0183.literal: Another edict urged the fortresses along the river in Jiading and other prefectures to submit early.
s0183.idiomatic: Another edict called on riverside fortresses in Jiading and neighboring prefectures to surrender promptly.

s0184.literal: Another edict ordered the Sichuan Branch Privy Council to send men to announce submission to the Jiang, Han, Yong, and Shu regions, listing officials' names by rank for replacement appointments — the meritorious were to be promoted, the capable employed;
s0184.idiomatic: Another edict told the Sichuan branch privy council to send envoys urging submission in the Jiang, Han, Yong, and Shu regions, with officials' names listed by rank for new appointments — the meritorious to be promoted, the capable put to use;

s0185.literal: those among the people without livelihood were to be given clothing and grain in relief, and those wishing to move inland were to be granted fields and houses so that they would not be left destitute.
s0185.idiomatic: people without means of living were to receive clothing and grain, and those who wished to move inland were to be given fields and houses so they would not be left destitute.

s0186.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengshen day, Prince Qebek was given a campaign seal.
s0186.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the twelfth month Prince Qebek received a campaign seal.

s0187.literal: On xinyou day an edict changed the Sichuan Branch Privy Council to a Branch Secretariat; Sayyid Ajall, Yesu Dai'er, and others were appointed to administer branch secretariat affairs.
s0187.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict converted the Sichuan branch privy council into a branch secretariat, with Sayyid Ajall, Yesu Dai'er, and others placed in charge.

s0188.literal: On jiazi day smelting offices were established on all routes.
s0188.idiomatic: On jiazi day smelting offices were established on every route.

s0189.literal: Because Liang Cheng had captured a Song commander alive, he was appointed Vice Director of the Kaifu Office and granted a gold tally.
s0189.idiomatic: Liang Cheng, who had taken a Song commander alive, was made vice director of the Kaifu office and given a gold tally.

s0190.literal: The bamboo levy of Hui Prefecture was reduced; previously the government took six-tenths, and now two-tenths were cut.
s0190.idiomatic: Hui Prefecture's bamboo levy was reduced from six-tenths to four-tenths of the harvest.

s0191.literal: On dinghai day an edict ordered Duke of Ansou Zhang Rou, Acting Minister of Works Duan Tianyou, and others jointly to administer works affairs and repair the palace city.
s0191.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict ordered Duke Zhang Rou of Ansou, acting minister of works Duan Tianyou, and others to oversee public works and repair the palace city.

s0192.literal: The Directorate of the Imperial Storehouse was merged into the Palace Domestic Service, and the palace domestic commissioner was placed solely in charge of directorate affairs.
s0192.idiomatic: The imperial storehouse directorate was merged into the palace domestic service, with the palace domestic commissioner placed solely in charge.

s0193.literal: An edict granted Goryeo the calendar for the fourth year of Zhiyuan and sent words of reassurance.
s0193.idiomatic: An edict granted Goryeo the calendar for Zhiyuan 4 and sent words of reassurance.

s0194.literal: The Great Peace Pavilion was built at Shangdu.
s0194.idiomatic: The Great Peace Pavilion was built at Shangdu.

s0195.literal: The Jinkou channel was opened to divert Lugou water for transporting timber and stone from the Western Hills by canal.
s0195.idiomatic: The Jinkou sluice was opened to channel Lugou water and float timber and stone from the Western Hills by canal.

s0196.literal: An order stated: "All private merchants crossing borders and spies, together with makers of forged notes, are to be sent to the capital for examination."
s0196.idiomatic: An order declared: "Private cross-border traders, spies, and makers of forged notes are to be sent to the capital for review."

s0197.literal: That year throughout the empire there were 1,609,903 households.
s0197.idiomatic: That year the empire registered 1,609,903 households.

s0198.literal: Locusts at Dongping, Jinan, Yidu, Pingluan, Zhending, Luoci, Shuntian, the Central Capital, Hejian, and Beijing; drought at Jingzhao and Fengxiang.
s0198.idiomatic: Locusts plagued Dongping, Jinan, Yidu, Pingluan, Zhending, Luoci, Shuntian, the Central Capital, Hejian, and Beijing; Jingzhao and Fengxiang suffered drought.

s0199.literal: Ninety-six persons were sentenced to death.
s0199.idiomatic: Ninety-six persons were sentenced to death.

s0200.literal: The princes were granted gold, silver, coin, and silk according to the annual custom.
s0200.idiomatic: Princes received gold, silver, currency, and silk as in the annual custom.
